summary: Use a Popup for a short, focused moment, such as an offer or a reward, that slides up over the screen and asks for one choice.

useWhen.text: A short, focused moment, such as an offer or a reward, that slides up over the screen and asks for one choice.

from.quote: Use a Popup for a short, focused moment, such as an offer or a reward, that slides up over the screen and asks for one choice.

useWhen.text: One short message and a choice, then back to the screen.

from.quote: One short message and a choice, then back to the screen.

useWhen.text: Rewards after a payment: once the payment is done, the screen opens a rewards popup.

from.quote: After a payment the screen opens a rewards popup.

avoidWhen.text: Leaving people no way out: with no Later and scrim taps off, only Escape closes it, and phones have no Escape key. Offer a way out, such as Later.

from.quote: With no Later and scrim taps off, only Escape closes it, and phones have no Escape key.

avoidWhen.text: Long content: it fills the screen, and people must scroll to reach the buttons. Keep it short.

from.quote: Long content fills the screen, and people must scroll to reach the buttons.

anatomy.holds: Yours: any pressable (trigger). Pressing it opens the popup over the whole screen.

from.quote: Yours: any pressable. Pressing it opens the popup over the whole screen.

anatomy.holds: Dims the whole screen behind the sheet while the popup is open.

from.quote: Pressing it dims the whole screen with a scrim

anatomy.holds: Slides up from the bottom: white, with 20 px top corners and 24 px of space at the bottom.

from.quote: slides up a white sheet with 20 px top corners and 24 px of space at the bottom.

anatomy.holds: One centred stack of your content (children), with 8 px of padding and 8 px between items.

from.quote: The sheet holds one centred stack of your content, with 8 px of padding and 8 px between items.

placementAdvice.text: Only the trigger sits in the page; the popup itself opens over the whole screen.

from.quote: Only the trigger sits in the page.

placementAdvice.text: The sheet spans the whole window, as it spans a phone screen, and grows with its content up to 90% of the window's height; taller content scrolls inside it.

from.quote: The sheet spans the whole window, as it spans a phone screen, and grows with its content up to 90% of the window's height; taller content scrolls inside it.

placementAdvice.text: With short content, such as a title and two buttons, the sheet hugs it at the bottom of the screen.

from.quote: A title and two buttons: the sheet hugs them at the bottom of the screen.

placementAdvice.text: It is a React Native Modal: on the web it opens over the whole browser window, never inside a frame, so the guide's examples, like Storybook's, open it from a button.

from.quote: In code it’s a React Native Modal: on the web it opens over the whole browser window, never inside a frame, so these examples open it from a button, as Storybook does.

configuration.text: Opened by its trigger: the popup opens when its trigger is pressed and keeps its own open state.

from.quote: The popup opens when its trigger is pressed and keeps its own open state.

configuration.text: Opened by the screen: the screen decides when it's open (open), for example after a payment, and hears every close (onOpenChange).

from.quote: The screen decides when it's open, for example after a payment, and hears every close.

configuration.text: Its ref, PopupRef, has open() and close(), which open and close the popup.
A button in the sheet closes it from inside: Later closes it; Claim would carry on with the task.

from.quote: Later closes it from inside; Claim would carry on with the task.

configuration.text: The scrim's strength is a setting, backdropOpacity: 0.3, 30% black, lets more of the page show through than the default 50%.

from.quote: 30% black lets more of the page show through than the default 50%.

configuration.text: With scrim taps off (closeOnBackdropPress false), a tap on the dimmed page does nothing: in the guide's example, which has a Later button, only Later or Escape closes it.

from.quote: Only Later or Escape closes it; a tap on the dimmed page does nothing.

configuration.text: The sheet springs up when it opens, but slides away over its close speed, animationDuration (250 ms by default).

from.quote: it springs up but slides away over its close speed

configuration.text: Modes on the popup reach its stack: Slot gap sets the space between items, and Page type the stack's padding.

from.quote: Modes on the popup reach its stack: Slot gap sets the space between items, and Page type the stack's padding.

configuration.text: Slot gap L puts 24 px between the title and the buttons; the default, S, is 8 px.

from.quote: Slot gap L puts 24 px between the title and the buttons; the default, S, is 8 px.

configuration.text: On a sub page (Page type SubPage), or JioPlus, the stack's padding grows from 8 to 16 px, at the default Padding and Stack Context.

from.quote: On a sub page, or JioPlus, the stack's padding grows from 8 to 16 px.

configuration.text: The trigger takes the popup's modes.

from.quote: the trigger takes the popup’s modes

rules.text: Lead with what's in it for people, add one supporting line, then a main action and a quiet way out.

from.quote: Lead with what's in it for people, add one supporting line, then a main action and a quiet way out.

rules.text: An offer: one headline, one line of detail, a main action such as Avail now, and a quiet way out such as Maybe later.

from.quote: One headline, one line of detail, Avail now, and Maybe later.

rules.text: Keep it short: a title and two buttons fit any screen.

from.quote: A title and two buttons fit any screen.

examples.purpose: Rewards after a payment, the guide's In context: the screen opens the popup (open) once the payment is done. Claim or Later closes it and the screen notes the choice; a tap on the dimmed page or Escape just closes it, which the screen hears through onOpenChange. A centred Title with one supporting line, then Claim and, under it, Later at Emphasis Low, the quiet way out, in a VStack that stretches to the sheet's width, as the guide builds it. The literal open and the empty handlers stand for the screen's own state.
examples.jsx:
<Popup open onOpenChange={(open) => {}}>
  <Title title="Your rewards are waiting" subtitle="Claim your points and enjoy the benefits now." textAlign="Center" />
  <VStack style={{ alignSelf: 'stretch' }}>
    <Button label="Claim" onPress={() => {}} />
    <Button label="Later" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ Emphasis: 'Low' }} />
  </VStack>
</Popup>

from.quote: After a payment the screen opens a rewards popup. Claim or Later closes it and the screen notes the choice; a tap on the dimmed page or Escape just closes it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is open (controlled mode).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called by the trigger, the ref, the scrim, and Escape (web) or back (Android). Declared: Called when the open state changes.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Rendered in place before the modal and cloned with an onPress that opens the popup; it receives the popup's modes. Declared: Element that triggers the popup when pressed. Its existing onPress is preserved.

props.name: children
props.description: One slot, wrapped in a VStack with the popup's modes, centred horizontally. Declared: Slot content displayed inside the popup.

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration for design token resolution.

props.name: closeOnBackdropPress
props.description: Off, a click on the scrim does nothing and Tab stays on the sheet; on, the scrim isn't a Tab stop and a click closes. Declared: Whether pressing the backdrop closes the popup. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: backdropColor
props.description: Backdrop overlay color. Default "#000000", from the component source.

props.name: backdropOpacity
props.description: The scrim's colour and opacity are props, not tokens; Overlay's scrim token is 70% black. Declared: Maximum backdrop opacity when fully visible. Default 0.5, from the component source.

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: The opening spring ignores it; the scrim fades in over it, and closing slides the sheet and fades the scrim over it (ease in-out), then unmounts. Declared: Animation duration in ms for transitions. Default 250, from the component source.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the popup container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: On the web the dialog has role dialog and aria-modal true, named by accessibilityLabel (“Popup” by default). Declared: Accessible name for the dialog. Defaults to "Popup". Default "Popup", from the component source.

props.name: ref
props.description: Popup forwards a ref of type PopupRef, with open() and close().

modes.name: Background
modes.description: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context
modes.description: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Padding
modes.description: None removes the inner stack's padding (0). Declared: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Page type
modes.description: With Padding Default and Stack Context Root, the inner stack's padding is 8 px on MainPage and 16 px on SubPage and JioPlus. Declared: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Slot gap
modes.description: The inner stack's gap: XS 2, S 8 (the default), M 16, L 24, XL 32 px; Context ListItem makes S 2. Declared: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Stack Context
modes.description: Nested gives the inner stack 12 px of padding (Root: 8 px on MainPage, 16 px on SubPage and JioPlus). Declared: A token collection Popup reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Element that triggers the popup when pressed. Its existing onPress is preserved.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Slot content displayed inside the popup.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Called when the open state changes.

gaps.text: Figma's Popup has no scrim; the code adds a 50% black one from props. The #268 fix left it unchanged; the evidence records it as Marcin's call.
